decisions.reason: A multi-model safety shoe line launched only a year ago is core to the firm's announced footwear direction and represents substantial tooling and development investment, so management will attribute any weak early results to market ramp-up.

The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements the shoe range and supports the tailored-solutions promise, though its low visibility and modest investment make it somewhat easier to drop than the shoe lines.
The supportive insole fits the firm's foot-measurement and ergonomic service offering, and one year is too short for management to judge it a failure.

The ergonomic series has its own dedicated page, which signals a visible public commitment and central relevance to the firm's 'tomorrow's footwear innovations' direction, so escalation pressures strongly favor keeping it.
Firefighter and rescue boots require heavy certification and development investment and open a specialist segment, so management will persist and blame slow uptake on long public procurement cycles.
Featuring the moulded insole on the home page is a highly visible public commitment that management would need to justify, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
